frameworkGaps.missing: Underpayment for penalty purposes is not reduced by withholding (§31 credits) the taxpayer did not claim on the return; penalty base uses tax required - tax shown only.
frameworkGaps.suggestedFix: In accuracyPenalty, compute underpayment = required - (shown + amounts previously assessed - rebates) where 'shown' for this purpose is net of withholding claimed, i.e. underpayment = pos((required - corrected.withholding) - (shown - asFiled.withholding)); equivalently subtract (corrected withholding - asFiled withholding) from the underpayment. Here 18,064 - 1,874 = 16,190 -> 3,238.
